mapper.select: SELECT monthly_income, monthly_rent_limit FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT up.deposit_limit AS target_deposit, ip.current_deposit AS current_deposit FROM user_profiles up INNER JOIN independence_progress ip ON ip.user_id = up.user_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT house_compare_completed_at FROM independence_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT move_in_date, moved_in_at FROM independence_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE independence_progress SET house_compare_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND house_compare_completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE independence_progress SET confirmed_house_id = #{confirmedHouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, move_in_date = #{moveInDate}, moved_in_at = #{movedInAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND move_in_date IS NULL
UPDATE independence_progress SET moved_in_at = #{movedInAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE move_in_date <= #{today} AND moved_in_at IS NULL
